records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarter ended January 1, 2022, 35% of revenue was recognized at the point in time control transferred to the customer.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The change in twelve-month backlog at January 1, 2022 as compared with the twelve-month backlog at January 2, 2021 was driven by increases in all segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin in the first quarter of 2022 decreased compared to the first quarter of 2021 due to operational inefficiencies, labor availability challenges and supply chain constraints related to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Research and development expenses in the first quarter of 2022 were in line with the same quarter a year ago.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our available borrowing capacity and our cash flow from operations have provided us with the financial resources needed to make organic investments, fund acquisitive growth and return capital to shareholders.
